title: Ceiling on the Young-Driver Loading for One Trip, Keyturn Guest Protection Plan
content:
The young-driver surcharge for one trip is held to a ceiling that follows the length of the cover charged on
the Keyturn Guest Protection Plan election, counted as the days carried by the protection fee lines standing on
that election.

**Where the protection fee lines standing on the election carry protection for 90 days or more**, the ceiling is
900.00 USD.

**Where the protection fee lines standing on the election carry protection for 30 days or more but fewer than 90
days**, the ceiling is 400.00 USD.

**Where they carry fewer than 30 days**, the ceiling is 150.00 USD.

## Both sides of the two thresholds

| Days of protection carried by the protection fee lines standing on the election | Ceiling on the loading |
|---|---|
| 89 | 400.00 USD |
| 90 | 900.00 USD |
| 29 | 150.00 USD |
| 30 | 400.00 USD |

The thresholds are met at the figure itself: protection fee lines carrying exactly 90 days take the 900.00 USD
ceiling, and protection fee lines carrying exactly 30 days take the 400.00 USD ceiling.

## Worked on hypothetical elections

An election whose protection fee lines together carry 120 days takes the 900.00 USD ceiling, so a loading that
would otherwise come to 1100.00 USD stands at 900.00 USD instead. An election whose lines carry 45 days takes
the 400.00 USD ceiling. An election whose lines carry 12 days takes the 150.00 USD ceiling, so a loading that
would otherwise come to 180.00 USD stands at 150.00 USD. Where the loading falls below the ceiling that applies,
the ceiling does not touch it.
